context: A rural uncle teaches a uni reporter about local crops
purpose: Teach: 大豆/エビ/日本酒/書物/ドラム/ドコモ/馬場/ローズ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 叔父さん、今日は地元の作物について取材させてください。大学の書物では学べないことを聞きたいんです。
lines.en: Uncle, please let me interview you about local crops today. I want to hear things I can't learn from university books.
lines.style: Polite university reporter requesting an interview from an elder relative

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: おう、よく来たな。うちの畑じゃ大豆が一番の自慢だぞ。味噌も醤油も全部これから作るんだ。
lines.en: Oh, glad you came. Soybeans are our biggest pride here. Miso and soy sauce all come from these.
lines.style: Warm rural uncle speaking proudly in casual countryside tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。ちなみに川の方ではエビも獲れるって聞きましたが、本当ですか?
lines.en: I see. By the way, I heard you can also catch shrimp in the river — is that true?
lines.style: Curious student asking follow-up question with respectful tone

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ああ、小さい川エビな。秋になると地元の蔵元が日本酒の肴にって買い付けに来るんだよ。
lines.en: Yeah, little river shrimp. In autumn the local sake brewery comes to buy them as snacks for their sake.
lines.style: Explaining local food culture with knowledgeable folksy pride

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それ、すごく面白いです!写真も撮りたいので、ドコモのスマホで動画も回していいですか?
lines.en: That's super interesting! I'd like to take photos, so can I also record video on my Docomo phone?
lines.style: Enthusiastic young reporter asking permission with modern eagerness

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 構わんよ。あっちの納屋にゃ古いドラム缶があって、昔はあれで大豆を運んだもんだ。
lines.en: Don't mind at all. In that barn there are old drums — we used to haul soybeans in them.
lines.style: Inviting and nostalgic, sharing practical farm history casually

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、ドラム缶で!ところで裏山の馬場跡みたいな所は何だったんですか?
lines.en: Wow, in drums! By the way, what was that horse-track-looking place on the back hill?
lines.style: Genuinely surprised reporter probing about a curious local landmark

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ああ、昔は競馬場の馬場だったが、今はローズマリーやハーブを育てる畑になっとる。
lines.en: Ah, used to be a racetrack course, but now it's a field where we grow rosemary and herbs.
lines.style: Nostalgic uncle explaining gentle transformation of village land

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大豆にエビに日本酒、ローズマリーまで…一つの村にこんなに豊かさが詰まってるんですね。
lines.en: Soybeans, shrimp, sake, even rosemary — one village holds so much abundance, doesn't it?
lines.style: Reflective closing remark from impressed and moved young reporter
